About This Game

Your hammer can make a fortune. The next hit can turn it to scrap.

ForgeTax is a dark, first-person roguelite about forging swords, bending the odds, and paying tribute to the dragon that owns your forge.

HAMMER YOUR LUCK


Heat a blade. Bring it to the anvil. Push its value higher with every successful strike—or watch it shatter. Forge the same sword 10 times to charge Frenzy, then unleash it on the next hit: a brief, blazing window to hammer without fear of shattering.

TURN SWORDS INTO SYNERGIES


The relic machine takes swords. Every blade you spend on a relic is one less blade for the dragon. Change your draw tickets, combine strange effects, and turn a handful of advantages into ridiculous value. Build around your luck, or change what luck means.

THE DRAGON IS WAITING


Lay your swords on the counter and ring the bell. Meet the tribute and earn another round at the anvil. Fall short, and something beyond the bars begins to lose patience. Decide what to keep, what to sacrifice, and when to stop swinging.

Pay the dragon. Forge your revenge.

AI Generated Content Disclosure

The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of selected Steam store promotional images, certain audio assets, and a limited number of 3D assets. AI tools were also used to assist with translation and localization. No live-generated AI is used during gameplay.
